title: Romantic Getaway to Quebec: A Couple's Guide for 2026
metaDescription: Plan the perfect romantic trip to Quebec. Sunset spots, intimate dining, and unforgettable experiences for couples in love.
excerpt: Quebec sets the stage for romance like nowhere else. From sunset views to intimate dinners, this guide will help you plan the perfect couple's getaway.
author: Trypinn Team
content:
There is something about Quebec that captures the imagination of travelers worldwide. For those planning a romantic getaway to Quebec, this guide will show you the best of what awaits.

## Most Romantic Spots

- Sunset viewpoints that offer breathtaking panoramas over Quebec
- Secluded beaches and hidden coves perfect for private moments
- Candlelit restaurants serving the finest local cuisine
- Scenic walks through charming neighborhoods and historic streets

![Romantic Quebec](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1540638185826-7b1a01210c2b?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Romantic Activities

A private boat tour around Quebec at sunset is the perfect way to create lasting memories together.

## Where to Stay

Charming bed and breakfasts in Quebec provide cozy accommodations with home-cooked breakfasts.
